parts.t: Some complexes come up often enough that I built them their own page with current listings:
Tour two or three of these on the same afternoon. Unit layouts, parking and how close the visitor stalls are can be very different even a block apart.
Two townhomes at the same price can live very differently. Here's what I walk buyers through:
Side-by-side double, tandem, or a single with a pad. Measure it if you have a truck.
Some end units have a real fenced yard. Many inside units have a small patio or a deck only.
Three-storey plans with the main living on the middle floor are common. If stairs are a concern, look for a main-floor bedroom.
In most complexes the strata looks after roofs, siding and landscaping. Check the bylaws to see what's yours, like decks, windows or the garage door.

Where does the City plan for townhouses in South Surrey?
Grandview Heights, east of Highway 99, has several neighbourhood plans with land set aside for townhouses. The Rosemary Heights Central plan and the Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan also allow them.
Do South Surrey townhomes come with a garage?
Many do, but not all. Double side-by-side and tandem garages both show up, so check the layout and measure if you have a bigger vehicle.
Who pays for a new roof in a townhouse complex?
Usually the strata, from the contingency reserve fund or a special levy. The depreciation report and the bylaws tell you what the strata covers and what you cover.
Are White Rock townhomes on this page?
Yes. The search covers the MLS® area South Surrey White Rock, so townhomes inside the City of White Rock are included.
What is the South Surrey townhouse benchmark?
FVREB publishes a monthly townhouse benchmark for White Rock / South Surrey.
